```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(emplikDTA)
set.seed(34)
```

## Simulated data

```{r}
mu_true <- c(0, 1)
sigma_true <- c(1, 1.1)

n1 <- 15
n2 <- 15

X1 <- rnorm(n1, mu_true[1], sigma_true[1])
X2 <- rnorm(n2, mu_true[2], sigma_true[2])
```

## Compute AUC

```{r}
auc(x = X1, y = X2)

data_test <- data.frame(
  biom = c(X1, X2),
  diag = rep(c("1", "2"), c(n1, n2))
)

auc(formula = biom ~ diag, data = data_test)

auc(formula = biom ~ diag, data = data_test, ci_level = 0.9)

auc(
  formula = biom ~ diag,
  data = data_test,
  diag_levels = c("2", "1")
)

out_test <- auc(formula = biom ~ diag, data = data_test)
print(out_test)
```

## Plot

```{r}
auc(
  formula = biom ~ diag,
  data = data_test,
  plot = TRUE
)
```
